name: io.github.mikimatsub/swsd
description: MCP server for SolarWinds Service Desk: tickets, service catalog, knowledge base, change/release workflows, assets/CMDB, procurement, and risk context.

environmentVariables.name: SWSD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SolarWinds Service Desk admin token (JWT). Generate in the SWSD UI: Setup -> Users & Groups -> Users -> [your user] -> Actions -> Generate JSON Web Token. Service Desk administrator rights required.

environmentVariables.name: SWSD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SWSD API base URL. US tenants: https://api.samanage.com (default). EU tenants: https://apieu.samanage.com.

environmentVariables.name: SWSD_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool registration profile: 'triage' (14 read-heavy tools), 'agent' (37 default), 'knowledge' (15 KB-author), 'operations' (64 ITSM operations tools), 'full' (66 every tool).

environmentVariables.name: SWSD_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write safety mode: 'live' calls SWSD normally; 'dry-run' returns write payload previews without sending writes; 'disabled' rejects write tools.
